_what: The monthly cache for channels/review_assignment.py. A wake refreshes the prices from current published rates and dates the file; the assignment draw reads the band below instead of re-deriving prices every turn.
unit: USD per million tokens, blended in+out, from the session ledger
_note: Desi and Dmitri are the same model (DeepSeek) and therefore the same price, so the least expensive set has two members — a band, not a winner. The monthly job replaces these prices with current published rates; the source field is what makes a stale file visible instead of authoritative. Dmitri's figure is inherited from DeepSeek's, not separately measured, and is marked as inherited here rather than presented as a reading.
